The walk-band plate at BAND_B_RUNG now draws the compass rose iterated outward from the observer instead of a Mercator projection: the box to the left IS where the left arrow goes, at every facet on every face. Decisions 0906 (the raster) and 0907 (a preregistered check must name the axis it could fail on).
